phase: One bounded diagnostic of first and subsequent target-load trials in the same application process
reason: Three 600-RPS sustained trials failed after low-rate warmup. The surrogate RR inner statement rate was only 514/536 RPS early, caught up at 634/654, then held about 599. Separate initial-transient effects from a persistent throughput boundary before choosing the final steady-state protocol.
interpretation: This pair is diagnostic, not a final capacity or key/isolation superiority claim. A difference cannot by itself distinguish JVM JIT, application caches, thread initialization and database-cache effects. Preserve both outcomes.
nextDecision: If the subsequent trial passes, define an explicit target-load conditioning stage for all steady-state variants before a new five-round series. If it still fails, select a lower target from the retained exploration. Do not pool initial and revised protocols.
